note: Manual override of 'Shows You Watch Together' co-watching progress, for the case where Trakt's own export data (library.json/currentlyWatching.json) is stale relative to right now - either because Bill hasn't uploaded a fresh export yet reflecting real, recent watching, or because he's corrected the real watched-state directly in Trakt (unmarked episodes that were wrongly bulk-marked watched) but hadn't re-exported yet. This app has no live connection to Trakt by design (see CLAUDE.md's standing rule) - it only ever reflects whatever was in the last uploaded export zip, so a fix made directly on trakt.tv is invisible here until a fresh export is uploaded and re-imported. See build_trakt_library.js's hasConfirmedWatchDate comment for the deeper investigation into why 'fully placeholder-dated, plays==airedEpisodes' can't be trusted or distrusted by code alone. Populated directly from what Bill tells us in chat, never inferred or guessed. status: 'caught-up' means treat this show as NOT ready to watch together right now, regardless of the computed episode count. status: 'behind' means treat it as ready to watch together even if Trakt's own numbers say otherwise. Clear an entry (or refresh its updatedAt) once a fresh Trakt export makes the real plays count trustworthy again for that title - none of these are meant to be permanent. Tires and Hacks were cleared on 2026-09-18 after a fresh Sep 17 export confirmed their real state directly (Tires: plays=30/30, genuinely caught up; Hacks: plays=37/47, genuinely in-progress). Euphoria was cleared the same day, differently: Bill confirmed he'd fully reset it in Trakt to unwatched (not just corrected a partial mismark) - the Sep 17 export's own data backs this up exactly (it's gone from watched-shows AND ratings-shows entirely, and it's now genuinely on his real watchlist, added 2026-09-12), so its stale library.json entry (plays=24/24, caught-up) was removed outright rather than left for a future import to overwrite, matching the real, current, fully-confirmed Trakt state.
